'''2008 Worlds Team Blake Huffman LS We Have A Plan''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Blake Huffman]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Team Tournament). Sheet title I Have 37 Virtual Cards In My Deck!


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Blake Huffman]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[We Have A Plan / They Will Be Lost And Confused (V)|We Have A Plan (V)]]
* '''Stage:''' Team Tournament
